name: RPG Maker XP

decoders.tileset: RPGTilesheetXP: 8 tiles wide, any height; tile 0 is the eraser
decoders.autotile: RPGTilesheetXP: 96x128 XP quarter layout (47 variants); wider files animate (96 px per frame, up to 8); 32 px high strips are plain repeating tiles
decoders.charset: RPGCharset: one character per file, 4 frames x 4 directions

limitations: tile priority and terrain tags are not in the images: imported from a project they come from Data/Tilesets.rxdata; otherwise tiles get documented defaults and a review warning
an RTP has no Data/Tilesets.rxdata: autotiles are paired with tilesets only where the RTP file names are clear (G_ Grassland, Sn_ Snowfield / SnowTown); the rest are picked by hand
